This shared target indicates that the compound may exert its biological effects through a common pathway, likely involving the activation or inhibition of this kinase. The consistent presence of the same target across different compounds supports the hypothesis that the compound may act through a specific mechanism that modulates the activity of this kinase, potentially influencing downstream signaling pathways. The evidence is robust and aligns with the expected biological role of this kinase in cellular processes, making the proposed relationship a plausible and mechanistically supported interaction.
